svg.title: OSCoST HAT, bottom side with the silkscreen wiring cheat sheet
svg.desc: Bottom side of the 1-Wire edition seen from below: pin names at every terminal, a table of all terminals, the safety notes, the R25/R26 rule, the LED meanings, a box to tick the build, and a QR code to the repository.
svg.text: Open Source Controller for Solar Thermal · MIT licence
! Solar-profile PWM pump only: no signal = stop
! No 230 V on this board. Power: from the Pi only
! R25 0 Ω = 12 V drive · R26 0 Ω = 5 V (Lite) · never both
LEDs: PWR on · WD heartbeat · PUMP running · R1 relay on
Bottom view, seen from below (mirrored against the top view), to scale (1 mm = 8 px).
White = silkscreen. Text at least 1 mm high; most of it is 1.2–1.4 mm. The bottom side holds no parts.
Pin names repeat on the top side next to every terminal, where they can be read while wiring.
